label: THREE CITIES
caption_lead: Three cities from ATL, all under their typical fare.
plan_angle: Expedia's 2026 Air Hacks Report puts Friday as the cheapest day of the week to book a flight, about 3% under Sunday, and the cheapest day to fly overall, up to 8% under a Sunday departure. Worth knowing: for US domestic routes specifically that report still has Tuesday as the cheapest day to actually fly, roughly 14% under Sunday.
